alternatives_rejected.why: frontend latency-90 deviation (z=93.9) is roughly 80x smaller than recommendationservice's (z=7528.8), consistent with a caller absorbing a slow downstream (E1).

the socket deviation (z=45.2) is minor next to the latency explosion (E3). The inbound error rate of 0.15 with zero own-span errors fits caller timeouts from delay better than connection failures (E2).
the mem deviation (z=42.9) is small compared with latency (E3). Logs show only normal INFO request handling, with no OOM or GC errors (E4).

proposed_fix.description: Inspect recommendationservice's pod and network config for injected latency (e.g. tc/netem qdisc or chaos experiment) and remove it. Then confirm p90 latency and frontend inbound error rate return to baseline. Meanwhile, tighten the frontend's timeout on the recommendations call and fall back gracefully so failures don't cascade.
